column7: Found live by this same fix's own 10-minute fuzz-validation burst, same createuser-best-effort-panic-002/-003 shape: RevokeBreakGlassActivationAtomic's post-commit evictUserSessionCache call (internal/core/account.go) had no panic protection -- a panic there, after the role removal + activation-revoke had already committed, skipped the LogBreakGlassRevoked audit call that follows it and surfaced as a request failure despite the state having already fully changed, oracle (a): Differing tables [UserRole AuditEvent BreakGlassActivation]. Fixed at evictUserSessionCache's own single choke point (defer/recover + SECURITY log line, matching emitAudit's existing pattern) -- closes it for its other two call sites in rbac_management.go too, not just the one the fuzzer reached it through. Proving test is the fuzz harness itself -- corpus entry c3012b444731c557 is the permanent regression. See docs/findings/2026-09-23-FINDING-breakglass-revoke-half-commit.md. Regression-corpus fidelity note (2026-09-27): ADR-108 Phase 6 step 14c's opCatalog shrink silently retargeted this corpus file's decoded operation from "REST POST /api/v1/groups/{id}/members" to an unrelated op -- repaired by re-encoding the file's byte[0] to the same op's new index, verified to decode back to the original op/method/NthCall/kind tuple; guarded going forward by TestOpcatalogCorpusFilesTargetPinnedOps (server/faultops/opcatalog_corpus_pin_test.go).
